getblock_v1.json: the raw JSON-RPC getBlock response for a block holding one
System Program transfer sent as a version 1 (SIMD-0385) transaction.

Captured: 2026-11-12
Agave: solana-test-validator 4.2.2 (src:c9c6f328; feat:21b0d33a, client:Agave)
  from https://github.com/anza-xyz/agave/releases/download/v4.2.2/solana-release-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.bz2
solana-go: github.com/solana-foundation/solana-go/v2 v2.1.0 (go1.26.2 darwin/arm64)

Commands:
  .cache/agave-4.2.2/bin/solana-test-validator --reset --ledger .cache/agave-4.2.2/ledger --rpc-port 18899 --quiet
  cd "$(mktemp -d)" && go mod init capture && go get github.com/solana-foundation/solana-go/v2@v2.1.0
  go run . > block.json

The capture program airdrops 2 SOL to a fresh key, waits for finalization, then
sends a 1,000,000-lamport transfer built with
solana.TransactionV1Config(solana.TransactionConfig{ComputeUnitLimit: 10000,
LoadedAccountsDataSizeLimit: 65536}). It waits for the transfer to finalize
(signature 4Ra4SosTpT3Qxc9TzL1MS1YvDwFvuACnGahNK5Hrd9dBSuoRYpBbTDEUqdfN8dU8qKgYJCJQS1rESbBAyz5c81cK,
slot 147). It then posts getBlock(147, {commitment: finalized, encoding: json,
maxSupportedTransactionVersion: 1, transactionDetails: full, rewards: false})
and writes the response indented with json.Indent.
